findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_trial, estimate_cost, analyze_track, request_payment_link, get_job_status, search_open_loops, get_open_loop · Private data: start_trial, estimate_cost, get_job_status, get_token_balance, list_token_packs, purchase_token_pack, search_open_loops, get_open_loop · Public sink: start_trial, analyze_track, request_payment_link, purchase_token_pack · Destructive: analyze_track.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_trial, estimate_cost, analyze_track, request_payment_link, get_job_status, search_open_loops, get_open_loop · Private data: start_trial, estimate_cost, get_job_status, get_token_balance, list_token_packs, purchase_token_pack, search_open_loops, get_open_loop · Public sink: start_trial, analyze_track, request_payment_link, purchase_token_pack · Destructive: analyze_track

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
